description: Save what you learned from the style references as the workspace's style profile, as a new version (older versions stay readable). Study the references first: watch the uploads through media_link (count cuts, read the on-screen text against the frame) and read the person's notes. Send the whole profile, not a change; pass base_version (the version you read) so you never overwrite someone else's save, and reference_ids for every reference you studied. On-screen text names a Google Fonts lookalike.

base_version.description: The version you read (0 when there was none). A save in between makes this fail with INVALID_STATE.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

examples.description: Up to three captions written in this voice.

voice.description: How the captions sound, in a few words (e.g. dry, first person, no hype).

description.description: How the hook works, in a sentence.

example.description: One hook line written in this style.

on_screen.description: Whether the hook is also written on screen.

within_s.description: Seconds until the hook has landed.

length.description: Typical video length in seconds, with the usual range.

notes.description: Anything else worth copying (color grade, b-roll, sound) in plain words.

background.description: A box behind the text; null for none.

family.description: A Google Fonts family spelled exactly as listed. Apps' own fonts aren't listed: pick the closest lookalike and name the original in lookalike_of.

lookalike_of.description: What the references appear to use, e.g. TikTok Classic or Proxima Nova.

position.description: Where the text sits; keep it out of each network's buttons and caption area.

size_band.description: Letter height against the frame's height: small about 3%, medium 5%, large 8%, huge 12% or more.

width.description: Outline width in pixels on a 1080x1920 frame.

stroke.description: The outline around the letters; null for none.

on_screen_text.description: null when the references show no on-screen text.

cuts_per_10s.description: Average cuts in every 10 seconds (0 for one continuous shot).

first_cut_s.description: When the first cut lands, in seconds; null for none.

notes.description: E.g. cuts land on the beat, slower in the middle.

duration_ms.description: How long the move takes (punch_in, whip).

share.description: This type's fraction of all transitions; the shares add up to at most 1.

type.description: cut: a straight cut. punch_in: a sudden zoom on the same shot. whip: a fast blurred pan into the next shot.

zoom.description: punch_in only: the scale it jumps to, e.g. 1.15.

reference_ids.description: The style references this was learned from.

summary.description: The style in a sentence or two for the person, e.g. "Fast cuts, bold white Anton captions in the lower third, punch-ins on the beat."

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: style_profile_set
title: Save the style profile
